thread:
Ellen: Quick flag 7 Sam (Nimbus) reported lower perf/W on their new S-series boards when we applied kernel-k9 + q4-lite. Can we quick triage? @Raj

Sam (Nimbus): Run tag NIM-2026-03-18-k9. Measured 74 tokens/s @ 260W => 0.284 tokens/W vs our certified 0.33 for same seq=1024. Launch: `./bench --model rp-standard --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant q4-lite --kernel k9 --warmup 40`.

Raj: Two quick asks: 1) NVML sampling interval? 2) Any priming/short-context mixes? Those affect avg perf/W.

Sam (Nimbus): NVML=1s. No priming. Warmup 40.

Olga: Can you upload nvml CSV + perf counters (memcpy, l2) and the exact kernel compile flags? Also check firmware power governor (some S-boards default to eco).

bench-bot: job NIM-2026-03-18-k9 queued. Artifacts will be at s3://redwood-partners/nimbus/NIM-2026-03-18/

Sam (Nimbus): Uploaded nvml.csv and hwcounters.json. Flags: `-O2 -DKERNEL_K9 -march=x86-64`. dmesg clean.

Raj: Quick look: nvml shows low sustained SM utilization and periodic memcpy spikes at token boundaries. hwcounters show elevated memcpy_stall. Hypothesis: k9 introduced a prefetch/eviction path causing extra host-device copies.

Ellen: Can you repro A/B: k9+q4-lite vs k8+q4-lite and k9+q8? If k8 restores perf/W it's kernel; if q8 restores it's quant. Also ensure warmup>=200 and no powercap auto.

Sam (Nimbus): Running A/B now, warmup 200, NVML 1s, powercap set explicit to 300W. Will upload results in ~45m.

bench-bot: job NIM-2026-03-18-ab completed  artifacts: s3://redwood-partners/nimbus/NIM-2026-03-18/ab/ (nvml.csv, hw.json, logs.tar.gz)

Raj: Results: k8+q4-lite -> 100 tokens/s @ 300W => 0.333 tokens/W (baseline). k9+q8 -> 98 tokens/s @ 295W => 0.332 tokens/W. k9+q4-lite -> 76 tokens/s @ 262W => 0.290 tokens/W. So kernel+q4 interaction causes regression.

Olga: Next steps: 1) Nimbus to revert the eviction path in k9 and re-test. 2) We'll add a partner-runbook item: "always A/B kernel/quant during partner benching; standard config: seq=1024,batch=1,warmup=200,nvml=1s,powercap explicit". 3) GTM hold on public card until we have final validated numbers.

Ellen: I'll draft the embargo slide and schedule partner exec sync next week. Thanks team.
